findings.title: Index lists referenced but not supplied

findings.title: Flagged web results not excluded from evidence explicitly

findings.title: Budget limit conflicts with automatic 25% loosening
findings.problem: The system prompt says the budget stays the limit, but the tool schema automatically raises the budget by 25% when results are scarce, and the prompt does not say this raised budget must be reported as a miss.
findings.proof: A budget stays the limit when the shopper invites going over it; the reply names how to raise it.

findings.title: Rating-cell placeholder wording differs across files

findings.proof: The Rating column holds a rating a live listing states, or "no rating".
findings.fix: Use one placeholder phrase, defined once in system_prompt, and reference it from the catalog file.

findings.title: Price floor has no when-to-call guidance
findings.problem: rag.search lists a price floor as never loosened, but price_min has no guidance on when a shopper's limit is a floor and when to use it.
findings.proof: Never loosened: safety exclusions, a stated age range, a price floor, and the under-three rule
findings.fix: Add one sentence to the price_min description saying when to set it (e.g. a stated minimum) and that it is never relaxed.

findings.title: Pipeline narrative is verbose
findings.problem: The nine-stage pipeline prose restates rules that the 'Enforced by code' and Safety policy sections also state, such as the critic checks and the fixed-sentence ordering.
findings.proof: 1. Speech recognition (local model) -> transcript and confidence.
findings.fix: Keep one stage per line with its owner and output, and move each rule to the single section that enforces it.

findings.title: rag.search description restates Search rules
findings.problem: The rag.search description repeats the loosening order and the under-three rule that the system prompt already covers, and it lists the full category names count and detail that the schema does not need.
findings.proof: Loosening: when fewer products than `top_k` meet every filter, filters are loosened in this order until enough are found
findings.fix: Keep the loosening order in one place (the schema) and cut the restated rules from system_prompt, or the reverse.
